k_ob_rilis_judul.en: New release, straight to the channel

k_ob_rilis_isi.id: Tiap ada rilis baru di GitHub, bot ngabarin channel WhatsApp lo otomatis. Lo tinggal fokus ngoding.
k_ob_rilis_isi.en: Every new GitHub release is announced to your WhatsApp channel automatically. You just keep coding.

k_ob_grup_isi.id: Yang minta join di-approve otomatis. Yang dulu cabut atau dikick? Ditolak sama bot, lo nggak usah jagain.
k_ob_grup_isi.en: Join requests are approved automatically. Someone who left or got kicked before? The bot rejects them, no babysitting needed.

k_ob_lagu_judul.en: Old songs, when the mood hits

k_ob_lagu_isi.id: Sesekali bot ngirim potongan lagu jadul plus kata-kata kece ke channel. Nggak spam — cuma pas lagi mood.
k_ob_lagu_isi.en: Now and then the bot posts a snippet of an old song with a neat caption to the channel. No spam — only when the mood hits.

k_ob_hosting_isi.id: Punya project bot sendiri? Upload ZIP-nya, app ini yang jalanin. Log, input, restart — semua dari HP.
k_ob_hosting_isi.en: Have your own bot project? Upload the ZIP and this app runs it. Logs, input, restart — all from the phone.
